page.overview:
What is Tin?

Tin is used in all forms of the metal arts and is one of the original 8 basic metals the [https://mistborn.fandom.com/wiki/Lord_Ruler Lord Ruler] preached. It is also one of the slowest burning metals.

A Misting of Tin is often referred to as a Tineye, and a Tin Ferring will often be called a Windwhisperer.
